summary: עתד concerns readiness and preparation. An עתּוּד is a prepared he-goat for sacrifice or leadership, while the verb and adjective describe being ready.

senses.definition: He-goats are counted among flocks and can represent leaders of a people.
What is ready has been prepared for its appointed use or time.
People prepare themselves and prepare offerings for appointed purposes.

note: Proper names עֲתָיָה and עֲתָךְ are left for name review.
